Key regression interpretation: Flask 3.0.0 explicitly passes the computed method set into Werkzeug `Rule`; a PUT request returns 405 when the registered rule’s `methods` set lacks `PUT`, even if the URL path matches. Werkzeug 3.0.1’s relevant behavior is method filtering in `StateMachineMatcher`, conversion to `MethodNotAllowed` in `MapAdapter.match()`, automatic `HEAD` inheritance from `GET`, and strict-slash/merge-slash handling. No searched 3.0.1 change indicates that PUT was removed automatically; the likely cause is an altered/inferred view method set, route registration path, or a path/slash variant matching a different rule.
